mission_02: Real-world datasets almost always contain a mix of numeric and categorical columns, each requiring different preprocessing. ColumnTransformer applies different transformations to different subsets of columns and concatenates the results, all within a single pipeline step. This eliminates the error-prone manual splitting and recombining of columns. Numeric columns typically need imputation and scaling, while categorical columns need imputation and encoding. ColumnTransformer handles both in parallel, ensuring that each column type receives the appropriate treatment. When wrapped in a Pipeline with a final estimator, the entire preprocessing and modeling workflow becomes a single, portable object. This pattern is the standard approach for handling heterogeneous tabular data in sklearn and is essential for any production ML system.
